judge.reason: Both versions add the context-aware Encode/Decode, the Timeout and IntAsFloat fields, timeoutError, and the change that only treats exit code 1 as a parser error. X goes further. It adds a Parallel field that runs tests concurrently, with a semaphore, WaitGroup, mutex and a final sort. It also adds an Errors map: X checks that the output of invalid tests contains the expected error string, and returns an error when an entry in the map matches no test. Y has neither feature, so Y lacks behaviour that X provides. Y is simpler: it keeps findTests and puts the duplicated timeout and parse code int
